basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast from Manchester, UK, specializing in cybersecurity. I work as a systems analyst for a mid-sized IT firm. When not immersed in technology, I indulge in my hobbies: enjoying cigars, gaming (particularly horror-themed games like Friday the 13th), and exploring the latest in hardware. I’m usually online in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight. In a committed relationship with a fellow techie, we often discuss the latest in cyber news and gaming. Dislikes include ignorance towards basic cybersecurity practices and uninformed tech debates.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Proficient in cybersecurity and IT systems, with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. I have over a decade of experience in the field, including attending workshops and self-teaching through online resources. My job requires constant learning to stay ahead of cyber threats.
